findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_scientific_evidence" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_intelligence, search_scientific_evidence · Private data: score_prospect_fit, generate_outreach_sequence, get_deep_research · Public sink: generate_outreach_sequence, search_scientific_evidence · Destructive: generate_swot_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_intelligence, search_scientific_evidence · Private data: score_prospect_fit, generate_outreach_sequence, get_deep_research · Public sink: generate_outreach_sequence, search_scientific_evidence · Destructive: generate_swot_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
